oneLine: Soach Global eyes NSE IPO to pocket Rs 295 Cr via partial exit.

sources.title: Soach Global eyes 25X returns from NSE IPO, to pocket Rs 295 Cr via partial exit

synopsis: Mauritius-based Soach Global Opportunities Fund is pursuing a partial exit from its decade-old investment in the National Stock Exchange through the exchange's initial public offering. The fund is selling 20 percent of its holding, amounting to 16.5 lakh equity shares through an offer for sale, at a price band of Rs 1,700 to Rs 1,785 per share. This transaction is expected to fetch between Rs 280 crore and Rs 295 crore. Anubhav Dayal serves as the founder and director of Soach Global Opportunities Fund. The fund plans to retain the remaining 80 percent of its holding as a long-term investment. The NSE IPO opened on September 17 and closes today, having been subscribed 1.76 times by the final morning.
